passive.name: Purging Karmic Fire
passive.text: CRIT Rate increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper launches an **EX Special Attack**, their **Fire Sheer DMG** increases by **9/10.35/11.7/13.05/14.4%**, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 20s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Cloud Flow
passive.text: CRIT Rate increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper launches an **EX Special Attack**, the character gains 1 stack of **Qingming Companion** effect, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. On entering combat, immediately gain 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of the **Qingming Companion** effect increases the equipper's **Ether DMG** by **8/9.2/10.4/11.6/12.8%**, and increases Ultimate and EX Special Attack **Ether Sheer DMG** by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

passive.name: Summoning Arcanum
passive.text: When the equipper activates an **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's DMG by **4/4.6/5.2/5.8/6.4%**, up to 3 stacks, and lasting 20s. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by **6.5/7.5/8.5/9.4/10.4%**.

passive.name: Caged Fire
passive.text: The equipper's **Fire DMG** increases by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%**. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%** for 5s.

passive.name: Ingenious Craft
passive.text: Upon launching an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by **16/18.4/20.8/23.2/25.6%** for 12s. Additionally, if the target's current HP is below 50% of their Max HP, **EX Special Attack** DMG increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Easy Strides
passive.text: When launching a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect. Each stack increases the equipper's Sheer Force by **80/92/104/116/128**, stacking up to 3 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

substatLine: CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > HP% > ATK% > Flat HP
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Special Attack > Basic Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Towering Peaks
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Majestic Summit
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Immolate
entries.text:
While not in the **Visage of Wrath** state and with at least 120 **Wrathful Fires**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Deals **Fire DMG** to nearby enemies, then enters the **Visage of Wrath** state.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Inflame
entries.text:
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 **Wrathful Fires**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover **Wrathful Fires**. Upon reaching 120 **Wrathful Fires**, Banyue immediately enters the **Visage of Wrath** state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain
entries.text:
When Banyue is in the **Visage of Wrath** state, hold Basic Attack to consume 120 **Wrathful Fires** and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
After using this move, Banyue exits the **Visage of Wrath** state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks
entries.text:
While Banyue is in the **Visage of Wrath** state and after performing two different **EX Special Attacks** through Basic Attack branches or quick input commands, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
Banyue automatically follows up with **Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Immovable Mountain
entries.text:
While attacking, press Dodge without moving the joystick to activate:
Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's attack and accumulates Daze.
If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs.
Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.

entries.name: Dodge: Overcome Peaks
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Battle Cry
entries.text:
Rotate the joystick in a half-circle and press Dodge to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any **EX Special Attack**, follow up with **Dodge: Battle Cry** and quickly execute the required inputs during **Dodge: Battle Cry** to then follow up with the corresponding **EX Special Attack**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Scattering Sands
entries.text:
During a dodge, press Basic Attack, or during **Dodge: Battle Cry**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Towering Peaks** or the 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Majestic Summit**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Stoneburst
entries.text:
After a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered through **Dodge: Overcome Peaks**, press Basic Attack, or after a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered though **Dodge: Battle Cry**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals **Fire DMG**.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of **Basic Attack: Towering Peaks** or the 3rd hit of **Basic Attack: Majestic Summit**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Batholith
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Executes a series of attacks against enemies in front, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Iron Bastion
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lofty Ascent
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Pierce Heavens
entries.text:
After successfully parrying an enemy attack with **Dodge: Immovable Mountain**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing **Fire DMG**
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Towering Peaks**, press EX Special Attack to activate:
After an **Assist Follow-Up**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Quick Assist**, hold EX Special Attack to activate:
During an **EX Special Attack**, **Basic Attack: Immolate**, **Chain Attack**, **Ultimate**, **Assist Follow-Up**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Quick Assist**, quickly input Basic Attack EX Special Attack Basic Attack in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Majestic Summit**, press Basic Attack to activate:
During an **EX Special Attack**, **Basic Attack: Immolate**, **Chain Attack**, **Ultimate**, **Assist Follow-Up**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Quick Assist**, quickly input EX Special Attack EX Special Attack Basic Attack in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: One's Path
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Majestic Summit**, press Basic Attack to activate:
After an **Assist Follow-Up**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Quick Assist**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
During an **EX Special Attack**, **Basic Attack: Immolate**, **Chain Attack**, **Ultimate**, **Assist Follow-Up**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Quick Assist**, quickly input EX Special Attack Basic Attack EX Special Attack in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out his beads, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Towering Peaks**, press EX Special Attack to activate:
During an **EX Special Attack**, **Basic Attack: Immolate**, **Chain Attack**, **Ultimate**, **Assist Follow-Up**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Quick Assist**, quickly input Basic Attack Basic Attack EX Special Attack in sequence to activate:
Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline when using **EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker**, quickly input EX Special Attack EX Special Attack Basic Attack in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline when using **EX Special Attack: One's Path**, quickly input Basic Attack Basic Attack EX Special Attack in sequence to activate:
Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Cancel
entries.text:
When Banyue activates an **EX Special Attack** ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating **EX Special Attack** can be interrupted. Each **EX Special Attack** has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an **EX Special Attack** after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted **EX Special Attack**'s effect. Interrupting an **EX Special Attack** during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a **Perfect Cancel**.
While in the **Visage of Wrath** state and with **Mountain's Might**, **Perfect Cancel** is easier to trigger.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Blazing Wrath
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
If Banyue has more than 120 **Wrathful Fires**, he automatically enters the **Visage of Wrath** state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: The World Trembles
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
If Banyue has more than 120 **Wrathful Fires**, he automatically enters the **Visage of Wrath** state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: One With the Mountains
entries.text:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All **Fire DMG** Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover **Wrathful Fires** through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 **Wrathful Fires** for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 **Wrathful Fires** upon activating **Defensive Assist**;
Recover 4 **Wrathful Fires** when parrying an enemy with **Dodge: Immovable Mountain**, and recover 6 **Wrathful Fires** instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 **Wrathful Fires** upon triggering a **Perfect Dodge**, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 **Wrathful Fires**. When he possesses at least 120 **Wrathful Fires**, Banyue can enter the **Visage of Wrath** state by using **Basic Attack: Immolate**. While in **Visage of Wrath** state, Banyue can no longer gain **Wrathful Fires**. After Banyue uses **Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain**, he exits the **Visage of Wrath** state.
When entering the **Visage of Wrath** state, Banyue gains 4 **Mountain's Might**. If Banyue has **Mountain's Might**, launching an **EX Special Attack** no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 **Mountain's Might** and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the **Visage of Wrath** state, remove all **Mountain's Might**.
When possessing **Mountain's Might** in **Visage of Wrath** state, hold Special Attack to launch four different **EX Special Attacks** and **Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain** in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an **EX Special Attack** or **Assist Follow-Up**, he increases his Sheer Force by **300**, **Fire DMG** by **36%**, and CRIT DMG by **36%** for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Mountain's Zenith
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Support** or **Stun** character:
While in the **Visage of Wrath** state, when Banyue consumes **Mountain's Might** to unleash an **EX Special Attack** through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of **Vidyaraja**. Each stack of **Vidyaraja** increases his **Fire DMG** by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

entries.name: Greed Burns Like Fire
entries.text:
When Banyue hits an enemy with **EX Special Attack: One's Path** or **EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker**, he inflicts the **Tremor** state. In this state, enemies **Fire RES** is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s.
When **EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar**, **EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath**, **EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor**, **EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath**, **Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain**, and **Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks** hits an enemy in the **Tremor** state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%.
When **Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks** hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.

entries.name: Anger Cuts Like a Blade
entries.text:
The CRIT DMG bonus from the **Core Passive** is increased by an additional 15%, and the **Fire DMG** bonus is increased by an additional 15%.
While in the **Visage of Wrath** state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming **Mountain's Might** to unleash an **EX Special Attack**.

entries.name: Ignorance Binds Like Chains
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Purge Unit - Type Zero
entries.text: **EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath**, **EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath**, **Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain**, and **Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks** DMG increase by **30%**.

entries.name: Student
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Descended Vidyaraja
entries.text:
At any time, when Banyue uses an **EX Special Attack**, he also gains **Vidyaraja**.
The **Fire DMG** bonus from **Vidyaraja** is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s.
When activating **Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks**, Banyue deals **Fire DMG** equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies.
Using **Dodge: Battle Cry** immediately after an **EX Special Attack** also grants **Vidyaraja**.
